8:

10: - Use its headed Chromium, persistent Xvfb display, and SwiftShader configuration.
11: - Run `playwright-cli open http://localhost:3002` for the Pascal development server.
12: - Load a saved scene. Wait for actual geometry and the active WebGPU renderer.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build a complete, playable “Juego isekai (2D Game, Phone/Tablet)” game in the repository.

## Requirements
- Build now without clarification; make reasonable assumptions and briefly note them when finished.
- Support phone/tablet responsive layouts and usable touch controls.
- For visual checks, save small JPEG screenshots (viewport ≤1280px), and inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Created a self-contained HTML5 canvas adventure, “Elsewhere in the Grove,” with a cozy isekai story, quests, collectibles, slimes, combat, and touch/keyboard controls.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added initial game implementation in `index.html`: responsive UI, title/pause/ending screens, movement joystick, action buttons, quest/dialogue, health/XP, canvas scenery, player and enemy drawing, and gameplay loop.
- Extracted embedded JavaScript to `/tmp/opencode/game.js` and verified syntax with `node --check /tmp/opencode/game.js`.
- Started a local server with `python3 -m http.server 3002`.

### Active
- Validate the game in a browser and fix any issues found.

### Blocked
- Browser check is blocked because `playwright-cli open http://localhost:3002` failed: `Browser "chromium" is not installed; expected executable at /home/runner/.cache/ms-playwright/chromium-1243/chrome-linux64/chrome.`

## Next Move
1. Install the Playwright Chromium browser or use an available browser setup, then open `http://localhost:3002`.
2. Check title screen, gameplay controls, console errors, and mobile layout; save and inspect a latest small JPEG screenshot.
3. Fix issues and report assumptions and validation status.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: complete game implementation; primary file to continue editing.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted.
- Current build relies on inline JS in `index.html`; `/tmp/opencode/game.js` is only a generated syntax-check copy.

- Build a complete, playable “Juego isekai (2D Game, Phone/Tablet)” game in the repository.

- Build without clarification; make reasonable assumptions and briefly note them when finished.
- Support responsive phone/tablet layouts and usable touch controls.

- Created a self-contained HTML5 canvas adventure, “Elsewhere in the Grove,” with a cozy isekai story, quests, collectibles, slimes, combat, and touch/keyboard controls.

## Work State
### Completed
- Implemented title, pause, and ending screens; responsive HUD; movement joystick; action buttons; quests/dialogue; health/XP; canvas scenery, player and enemies; gameplay loop in `index.html`.
- Verified inline JavaScript syntax with `node --check /tmp/opencode/game.js`.
